description: Sample questions for RGSynapse (RGS Sec 1 and Sec 2), who already write some Swift and Python and build with AI assistants. A small Phase 1 sample that exercises the schema, not the full paper.

questions.title: Odd and even totals
questions.prompt: What does this Python program print?
questions.details: Traces a loop with a branch inside it, including where range() stops.

questions.title: Checking the AI's answer
questions.prompt:
You asked an AI assistant for a Python function that returns the largest number in a list. It wrote the code below.

Which test input shows that the function has a bug?
questions.details: Chooses a test case that exposes a wrong starting value.

questions.title: Swift to Python
questions.prompt: This Swift loop prints some numbers. Which Python loop prints exactly the same numbers in the same order?
questions.details: Compares loop bounds and step direction across two languages.

questions.title: Counting passes
questions.prompt:
An AI assistant wrote this code to count how many scores are 50 or more.

What does it print?
questions.details: Traces list indexing and notices which items the loop skips.
